title.zh: Why Zcash soared to $1,600 as Europe unlocks new ETP access
title.en: Why Zcash soared to $1,600 as Europe unlocks new ETP access

current_state.zh: 21Shares listed a physically backed Zcash ETP on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam, giving European brokerage investors direct ZEC exposure as the token briefly topped $1,600 and weekly shielded transactions reached their highest level since 2022.
